# glpi_plugin_fields_container (Data Source)

Look up a container of the GLPI Fields plugin and the fields it defines.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "glpi_plugin_fields_container" "cost" {
  label = "Cost"
}

output "field_names" {
  value = [for f in data.glpi_plugin_fields_container.cost.fields : f.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) GLPI numeric ID. Set id or label.
- `label` (String) Label of the container. Set id or label; the label must match exactly one container.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the container is active.
- `fields` (Attributes List) Fields of the container, ordered by name. Only the types text, textarea, richtext, number, url, date, datetime and yesno can be managed with glpi_plugin_fields_values. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields))
- `item_types` (List of String) GLPI itemtypes the container applies to.
- `name` (String) Internal name GLPI generated from the label.
- `type` (String) Where the container appears: dom, tab or domtab.

<a id="nestedatt--fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fields`

Read-Only:

- `label` (String) Label of the field.
- `mandatory` (Boolean) Whether the field must have a value.
- `name` (String) Key GLPI uses for the field's value.
- `read_only` (Boolean) Whether GLPI ignores writes to the field.
- `type` (String) Field type.
